description: C-CLS-4a exempt MT103 with a polite explicit question whether it has arrived -> payment_evidence and payment_query (§3.1 v0.7.10), still medium, payment_wait.
notes: §3.1: with evidence the class is payment_evidence; an explicit "has it arrived" also gives payment_query (same reading as E0287). Both are inside E5's set, so the exemption still applies. Two directory contacts are called James Smith (C010, C030); the From address is C010's, so display_name_mismatch is false and C-LNK-1 links C010 (one deal). Ledger has no row for 010 -> not received in full. Value date Mon 2026-11-02, received Fri 2026-11-06: 4 working days < 5 -> payment_wait. "No rush" is not a pressure word. payment_date = value date 2026-11-02 (body says 2 November).
